title: Tripled the emoji library, more than doubled the icon library
summary: The icon/emoji picker (class cards + calendar categories) went from 154 emoji to 466, and from 54 icons to 124 -- covering science/tech, tools, more sports, music, food, animals, faces, weather, travel, symbols, and office supplies.

Every new concept got both an icon and matching emoji sharing the same search keyword, so picking whichever style you prefer ("rocket" now finds both a rocket icon and 🚀🛰️🛸) works seamlessly instead of one option being available and not the other.
